  method — `/get`, `/changes`, `/set`, `/query` and `/queryChanges` for

[vtc] Let vtc-client address the call's hosting account
Spec (3cbb0c4): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L1647: "The `accountId` of every method call on a VTC data type ... that concerns a call is the id of that call's hosting account. A participant who answers, mutes, or leaves therefore sends `VTCParticipant/set` to the hosting account, not to their personal account. A user's calls can be spread across several hosting accounts; a client that lists them queries each account the user can access."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/mod.rs:150-170; crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/vtc_participant.rs:31-93; crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/vtc_call.rs; crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/vtc_recording.rs; crate-jmap-vtc-client/src/methods/vtc_livestream.rs
Now: Every method gets its accountId from session_parts(), which always returns the primary urn:ietf:params:jmap:vtc account. A client cannot answer, leave or mute in a call hosted in another user's (shared) account.
Change: Take an explicit account_id on each method, or add *_in(account_id, ...) variants. Keep the primary account as the convenience default.
